title: Driver app release: agency code login, release signing from an untracked keystore, iOS permission strings
goal: One driver app build serves every agency: drivers type their agency code once, and the release build is signed properly.
why: packages/driver_app/lib/core/constants/app_config.dart compiles TENANT_ID in (default is the demo tenant), so one build serves one agency; isProd compares with 'prod' while the rest uses 'production'; release builds are signed with the debug key (android/app/build.gradle.kts ~37); ios/Runner/Info.plist lacks location, camera and photo-library usage strings that geolocator and image_picker need.
steps: Backend routes/driver.ts: GET /api/v1/driver/agency/:code (public, before driver auth) looks up tenants.subdomain = lower(code) with status active/trial, returns { tenantId, name, logoUrl } (logo from the tenant's company settings via resolveTenantDb, optional); 10 per minute per IP via middleware/rate-limiter.ts; unknown -> 404 with a generic message.

Flutter: remove AppConfig.tenantId; add a tenant store (secure storage if the app already uses flutter_secure_storage, else the existing Hive box) holding tenantId and agency name. First screen when no tenant is stored: AgencyCodeScreen (text field, Continue, shows name + logo to confirm, "Not your agency?" back). Phone and OTP screens send the stored tenantId (X-Tenant-Id / body) exactly as today. Profile gets "Change agency" (clears session and tenant). isProd compares with 'production'.

Android signing: build.gradle.kts loads android/key.properties when present (storeFile, storePassword, keyAlias, keyPassword) into a release signingConfig; otherwise uses debug signing and logs a warning during the build. key.properties.example documents the four keys. .gitignore adds android/key.properties, *.jks, *.keystore.

iOS Info.plist: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription ("Your location is recorded when you check in and out of a trip."), NSCameraUsageDescription ("Take photos of odometer readings and receipts."), NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription ("Attach photos of receipts and documents."). Display name "TravelCRM Driver".

integration_test/agency_login_test.dart: enters the demo agency code (subdomain demo from seed-local), sees the agency name, enters the demo driver phone, uses the TEST_MODE fixed OTP, lands on My Trips. Update smoke_login_test.dart for the new first screen.
tests: backend/test/driver-agency.test.ts: known code -> name; unknown -> 404; suspended tenant -> 404; 11th request in a minute -> 429.
Flutter widget test for AgencyCodeScreen (valid code continues, invalid shows the error).
integration_test/agency_login_test.dart on emulator-5554 against fix-stack slot 0 (single mode, demo agency).
acceptance: No TENANT_ID dart-define anywhere (grep packages/driver_app and scripts).
`flutter build apk --release` succeeds with a throwaway key.properties (generate with keytool into %TEMP%, never commit) and without one (debug-signed fallback).
flutter analyze clean; flutter test green; integration test passes on the emulator.
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
tasklist | findstr /i "java.exe dart.exe flutter"   # must print nothing; if a build is running, wait and ask the orchestrator
goLiveVerify: Owner-held upload keystore and Play Console internal track; iOS build on a Mac with an Apple Developer account.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).
